-- Create a calendar table to generate months for 2023
DECLARE @start_date DATE = '2023-01-01';
DECLARE @end_date DATE = '2023-12-31';

CREATE TABLE #calendar (
    Month INT,
    Year INT,
    MonthName VARCHAR(20),
    MonthNumber INT,
    Quarter INT
);

WHILE @start_date <= @end_date
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO #calendar (Month, Year, MonthName, MonthNumber, Quarter)
    SELECT 
        MONTH(@start_date),
        YEAR(@start_date),
        DATENAME(MONTH, @start_date),
        MONTH(@start_date),
        CASE MONTH(@start_date)
            WHEN 1 THEN 1
            WHEN 2 THEN 1
            WHEN 3 THEN 1
            WHEN 4 THEN 2
            WHEN 5 THEN 2
            WHEN 6 THEN 2
            WHEN 7 THEN 3
            WHEN 8 THEN 3
            WHEN 9 THEN 3
            WHEN 10 THEN 4
            WHEN 11 THEN 4
            WHEN 12 THEN 4
        END
    SET @start_date = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @start_date);
END;

    c.MonthName,

INNER JOIN

GROUP BY 
    c.Year,
    c.MonthName
ORDER BY 
    c.Year,
    c.MonthNumber;

-- Drop the temporary calendar table

    LastQuarterOrders AS (
